newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel firm, premiums show signs of easing.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel firm, premiums show signs of easing.

text.p: NWE jet fuel was firm on Thursday as benchmark IPE futures pushed higher, but traders there were signs premiums were softening amid talk of arbitrage opportunities enticing Caribbean cargoes to Europe. "Premiums could soften a bit, but not that much because the premium on low sulphur remains so high," one trader said.
On the cif cargo market, premiums were pegged at Oct IPE +$35/+$36.
A U.K. refiner said they had cargoes they could offer but were declining to do so because of the lack of bids.
Barge premiums were put at Oct IPE +$20/+$22, fob ARA.
